name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band high overhead, kneel facing it, and grip the band with your arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your ribs until your hands reach about chin height.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly let your arms rise back to the start.
Keep your chest tall and do not lean back.
image_prompt_scene: Kneeling with the band anchored overhead and the arms extended up.
